messages:
Yara: FYI I just noticed console served another org's rows in a panel during the canary.
Yara: saw it at 14:42 when switching orgs quickly, panel showed org 101 data while logged into org 202
Sam: reproduced locally. steps:
Sam: 1) load dashboard as org 101
Sam: 2) prefetch hits /api/panel/87 (returns rows for org 101)
Sam: 3) quick-switch to org 202, open same panel -> still shows org 101 rows
Sam: snippet from proxy logs:
Sam: ```
INFO prefetch proxy req=pf-9 headers={"X-Org":"101","Cookie":"s=..."} cache_key="/api/panel/87"
INFO cache::hit key=/api/panel/87 returning payload org=101
INFO request(org=202) served cached payload(org=101)
```
Maria: looks like cache key excludes tenant context. we hedge on path-only keys in several places :/
Kevin: is this the prefetch sidecar or an upstream CDN? which cache layer is culpable?
Sam: prefetch sidecar in front of console server. edge/CDN wasn't involved in my run.
Olga: did we change any cache behavior in today's rollout? I remember a prefetch optimization shipped.
deploy-bot: rollout:prefetch-opt v3 -> ramped to 25% at 2026-03-21T14:30:00Z
Yara: telemetry also flagged an uptick in `console.prefetch.cache_hit_unscoped` around the same time
Maria: mitigation: rollback (if still live) + quick change to ensure tenant is part of cache key
Kevin: rollback initiated? if not let's stop the canary until it's fixed.
deploy-bot: rollback:prefetch-opt -> started at 2026-03-21T15:02:10Z by @Kevin
Sam: minimal fix: normalize tenant extraction and append to cache key. pseudo:
Sam: ```js
function tenantAwareKey(req){
 const t = getTenant(req); // header || session
 return `${t}|${req.method}|${req.url}`;
}
```
Maria: we need to audit all caches: prefetch, widget-cache, aggregated-prefetch, and telemetry buffer caches. any path-only keys may leak.
Olga: I'll grep for "cache_key=" and for buildCacheKey implementations. will open a PR for prefetch.
Yara: proposal: add a middleware getTenant(req) that centralizes header/session/cookie precedence
Maria: also add a regression test that does rapid org switches while prefetching to catch races
Kevin: owners: Olga (fix/PR), Maria (tests & audit), Sam (repro + logs), Yara (telemetry), Kevin (release approval)
Maria: one more: add an assertion in prefetch that response.meta.org == request.org before caching; fail-safe to not cache if mismatch
Sam: agree. also we should tag telemetry when we detect a mismatch and increment an alert counter
Yara: I created ENG-7890 to track this incident and the follow-ups
Olga: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prefetch/pull/462 includes cache-key change + unit tests + a stress integration test
Kevin: plan: 1) rollback (done) 2) merge PR + tests 3) deploy to staging and run stress harness 4) ramp with telemetry gates 5) sign-off
Yara: I added a dashboard tile under Console -> Prefetch -> Tenant Isolation showing cross-org hit rate
Sam: can we also add a quick rollouts badge that surfaces cross-org leak rate next to the canary status?
Maria: security notified (cc @security-team). low blast radius but tenant isolation bug needs postmortem.
security-team: acknowledged, will join postmortem and review any exposure windows
Olga: monitoring logs for 60m after rollback, will post updates
Yara: thanks. I'll draft a short postmortem once staging ramp looks clean and tests pass.
